open_points.subject: answer_request
open_points.text: The body is one JSON-RPC 2.0 message, read only after the size and token checks.
open_points.other_text: The id of every response is the body's id member when the body is one JSON object whose id is a string or an integer, and null otherwise; reading it checks nothing and decides nothing.
open_points.question: For a size or token refusal, must the body remain unread and the response id be null, or may the body be parsed to recover its id?

open_points.subject: serve_kernel
open_points.text: the first step that raises — InstallationRejectedError, RefusedError from the instance check, a store refusal, SandboxUnavailableError, StopRequiredError or any other exception — stops the sequence there and propagates unchanged to the caller, the same exception with its own reason
open_points.other_text: When run_start_sequence raises, which has already written the failing step's name, MUST write the exception's reason to standard error, without any token, credential value, configuration content or stack trace, open no entrance and return a non-zero exit code
open_points.question: For an arbitrary exception whose own reason contains protected information, must that reason be written unchanged or must the protected information be omitted?
